description: Single-file HTML/CSS/JS playground: three editors with line numbers and tab support, sandboxed live preview iframe via srcdoc, captured console panel with log levels, runtime error overlay, debounced auto-run, example templates, localStorage persistence.

criteria: code_playground_model_01.html is one self-contained coding playground (no libraries): three editor panes for HTML, CSS and JavaScript with line numbers, Tab insertion and undo-friendly editing, a preview rendered in a sandboxed iframe built from srcdoc that combines the three panes, a console panel that captures console.log/info/warn/error from the iframe via postMessage and shows them with levels and timestamps, uncaught runtime errors surfaced as an overlay or console entry with line hints, a Run button plus debounced auto-run, reset, and at least three working example templates, and persistence of all three panes to localStorage. The console capture must be real, not decorative.
